answers.question: Q1
answers.answer: [Pass] XYZ predicts/advises whether an issue may enter a Jog/Marathon proposal; Needle predicts the first subsequently observed action at an end-of-turn boundary. Both can reuse frozen identity, allowed evidence, canonical output validation, provenance, and fail-closed controls, but XYZ needs plan/review/PRS/freshness/dependency and admission authority while Needle needs pre-boundary history, horizon, and observed-label policy. A workflow example can establish recommendation usefulness only in a later user-facing study, not observational predictive accuracy by itself.

answers.question: Q2
answers.answer: [Should] Main only serializes/logs context and explicitly does not invoke a model; 710c writes pending work, spawns detached inference, publishes `last/<session>.json`, and scores prior recommendations. `os.replace` prevents torn-file reads but not stale publication because workers and output names are keyed only by session; test out-of-order prompt completions, prompt-id/version matching, feedback attribution, and pending-file replacement without claiming the race was run.

answers.question: Q3
answers.answer: [Blocker] Forty-four labels and 100% parsed/extracted names cannot certify quality: Needle #12 withdraws the claimed well-formed rate as mere name extraction and flags unpaired comparison errors. The serializer makes `no_action` an empty `answers` list, whereas evaluation must not convert a censored no-observed-action window or empty model abstention into that label. A current inconsistency is 710c inference allowing up to three recommendations despite its comment calling v0 top-1 and the system prompt requiring one best label.

answers.question: Q4
answers.answer: [Should] Deterministic code should enforce identity, plan/hash/review/PRS checks, holds for paused or parked work, queue/write locking, dependency and shared-contract conflict checks, contract/output validation, and preservation of trusted-plan-review bindings. Terra may summarize evidence and suggest grouping or escalation, but cannot authorize admission, override a hold, or infer missing facts; `cmd_jog_add` specifically resets existing terminal rows to pending and zero attempts, so it is not safe for automatic rescans.

answers.question: Q5
answers.answer: [Should] The smallest shared falsification is a frozen, independently labeled replay set with row/session identity, exact input snapshots, strict schema validation, and planted invalid/leakage/staleness controls, compared against deterministic local baselines and a stronger/manual reviewer. XYZ must separately measure false acceptance, stale/duplicate admission, grouping and writer contention; Needle must separately measure held-out next-action accuracy, label coverage, leakage, abstention/censoring, and remote/local predictor behavior.

answers.question: Q6
answers.answer: [Should] Narrow Terra to extraction/group suggestions if it falsely accepts ineligible issues or misses eligibility thresholds; use a stronger reviewer/model on the same frozen cases when ambiguity remains; stop when trustworthy provenance, fail-closed writer behavior, or valid prediction boundaries cannot be established. This no-tools CLI trial measures none of production accuracy, latency, billed cost, privacy/data handling, or concurrent-worker race behavior, so it cannot establish any of those guarantees.

limitations: Advice is based only on supplied snapshot evidence; no files, commands, models, APIs, queues, races, or benchmarks were executed.
The cited revisions are distinct; main and 710c hook behavior was kept separate.
